objective: Order the four stages of a butterfly life cycle, beginning with the egg.

facts: adults lay eggs, beginning the cycle again

arc: Establish the stages, model following the cycle, practise with support, then reconstruct the order independently.

blocks.brief: Introduce the butterfly as an animal that changes form through a repeating life cycle.
Establish egg, larva, pupa, adult in order; explain the return to eggs.
Complete two missing stage names with the established sequence available.

learner_action.evidence: Identify missing stages within a supported sequence

blocks.brief: Reconstruct all four stages beginning with egg, without the ordered answer displayed inside the task.
